summary_of_work_approaches.results: Highest level we tried was 8%. Lowest level was 2%. Highest level on outer wrap paper was better for reduction of sidestream irritation and aroma levels.

summary_of_work_approaches.experiment: Experiment with a higher level of Calcium Acetate Hydrate.
summary_of_work_approaches.result: 6% level was worse than 2% for sidestream irritation and aroma levels.

summary_of_work_approaches.experiment: Experiment with an even higher level of CaCl2 on HP paper.
summary_of_work_approaches.results: The 12% CaCl2 was not noticeably different from 8% on sidestream irritation and aroma and was somewhat worse on taste. However, 12% CaCl2 was lower on sidestream irritation.
MG65 was better than HP (both treated with 8% CaCl2) for reduction of sidestream irritation and aroma. Main problem was reduced deliveries.

summary_of_work_approaches.experiment: Experiment with 6.2k succ and 2% Calcium Acetate Hydrate on current outer wrap paper and different porosity inner wrap paper.
summary_of_work_approaches.result: Using the same outer wrap paper, the higher porosity inner wrap (2700 CARESTA) was better than the low porosity inner wrap (78063-5) for sidestream irritation and aroma reduction.
